difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a coherent F on a locally Noetherian X, the set of coherent subsheaves K of F whose support is nowhere dense in Supp(F) has a maximal element K, and for F' = F/K the support is unchanged, F' has no embedded associated points, and F' agrees with F on a dense open U meeting the support densely (source lines 487-509). The proof invokes the two algebra statements about removing embedded primes and their localisation behaviour, and identifies a valid U as the complement of the closure of the embedded associated points of F.
